Pasal 1
Dalam Peraturan ini yang dimaksud dengan:  1. Daerah adalah Kabupaten Buton.  2. Pemerintah Daerah adalah Bupati penyelenggara Pemerintahan Daerah  pelaksanaan urusan pemerintahan  kewenangan Daerah Otonom.
3. Bupati adalah Bupati Bu ton sebagai unsur  yang memimpin  yang menjadi
4. Perangkat Daerah adalah unsur pembantu Bupati dan  Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Daerah dalam penyelenggaraan  urusan pemerintahan yang menjadi kewenangan Daerah.
5. Dinas Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan  yang selanjutnya disebut Dinas PPPA adalah  Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan  Kabupaten Buton.
Anak,  Dinas  Anak - 4 ­
6. Unit Pelaksana Teknis Daerah Perlindungan Perempuan dan  Anak, yang selanjutnya disingkat UPTD-PPA adalah unit  pelaksana teknis daerah yang dibentuk Pemerintah Daerah  dalam memberikan layanan bagi perempuan dan anak yang  mengalami kekerasan, diskriminasi, perlindungan khusus  dan masalah lainnya.
7. Forum Perlindungan Korban Kekerasan yang selanjutnya  disingkat FPKK adalah forum koordinasi penanganan korban  kekerasan perempuan dan anak yang penyelenggaraanya  dilakukan secara berjejaring.
8. Perempuan adalah manusia dewasa berjenis kelamin  perempuan dan orang yang oleh hukum diakui sebagai  perempuan.
9. Anak adalah seseorang yang belum mencapai usia 18 tahun,  terrnasuk anak yang ada dalam Kandungan.
10. Orangtua adalah Ayah dan/atau ibu kandung, atau ayah  dan/atau ibu tiri atau ayah dan/atau ibu angkat.
11. Keluarga adalah unit terkecil dalam masyarakat yang terdiri  dari suami istri, suami istri dan anaknya, atau ayah dan  anaknya, atau ibu dan anaknya, atau keluarga sedarah  dalam garis lurus keatas atau kebawah sampai dengan  derajat ketiga.
12. Rumah Tangga adalah suami, istri, dan anak, orang-orang  yang mempunyai hubungan keluarga karena hubungan  darah, perkawinan, persusuan, pengasuhan, dan perwakilan,  dan/atau Pekerja rumah tangga dan menetap dalam rumah  tangga tersebut.
13. Wali adalah orang atau badan yang dalam kenyataannya  menjalankan kekuasaan asuh sebagai orang tua terhadap  anak.
14.Pendamping adalah orang atau perwakilan dari lembaga yang  mempunyai keahlian me\akukan pendampingan korban  untuk melakukan konseling, terapi dan advokasi guna  penguatan dan pemulihan diri korban kekerasan.
15. Badan peradilan adalah peradilan umum yang mempunyai  kewenangan untuk menerima, memeriksa, dan mengadili,  serta menyelesaikan setiap perkara yang diajukan padanya,  untuk mewujudkan penegakan hukum dan keadilan.
16. Masyarakat adalah perseorangan, keluarga, kelompok, dan  organisasi sosial dan/atau organisasi kemasyarakatan.
17. Kekerasan adalah setiap perbuatan yang berakibat atau  dapat mengakibatkan kesengsaraan atau penderitaan baik  fisik, seksual, ekonomi, sosial, dan psikis terhadap korban.
18. Kekerasan terhadap perempuan adalah setiap tindakan yang  berakibat atau mungkm berakibat kesengsaraan atau  penderitaan perempuan secara fisik, seksual, ekonomi,  sosial, psikis, termasuk ancaman tindakan tertentu,  pemaksaan atau perampasan kemerdekaan, baik yang terjadi  di depan umum atau kehidupan pribadi.
- 5­
19.Kekerasan terhadap anak adalah setiap tindakan yang  berakibat atau mungkin berakibat penderitaan anak secara  fisik, psikis, seksual, penelantaran, eksploitasi, dan  kekerasan lainnya.
20. Karban adalah perempuan dan anak yang mengalami  kesengsaraan dan/atau penderitaan baik langsung maupun  tidak langsung sebagai akibat dari kekerasan yang terjadi di  wilayah Kabupaten Buton.
21. Perlindungan terhadap perempuan adalah segala kegiatan  yang ditujukan untuk memberikan rasa aman yang  dilakukan oleh pihak kepohsian, kejaksaan, pengadilan,  lembaga sosial, atau pihak lain yang mengetahui atau  mendengar akan atau telah terjadi kekerasan terhadap  perempuan.
22. Perlindungan anak adaJah segala kegiatan untuk menjamin  dan melindungi anak dan hak-haknya agar dapat hidup,  tumbuh, berkembang dan berpartisipasi secara optimal  sesuai dengan harkat dan martabat kemanusiaan serta  mendapat perlindungan dari kekerasan dan diskriminasi.
23. Pelayanan adalah tindakan yang dilakukan sesegera  mungkin kepada korban ketika melihat, mendengar dan  mengetahui akan, sedang atau telah terjadinya kekerasan  terhadap korban.
24. Penuntutan adalah tindakan penuntut umum untuk  melimpahkan perkara ke pengadilan negeri yang berwenang  dalam ha! dan menurut cara yang diatur dalam undang undang dengan permintaan supaya diperiksa dan diputus  oleh hakim di sidang pengadilan.
25. Gugatan adalah pemberitahuan disertai permintaan oleh  pihak yang berkepentingan kepada hakim untuk menindak  menurut hukum seseorang yang telah merugikan dirinya  secara keperdataan.
26. Rumah Aman adalah rumah singgah untuk korban, selama  proses pendampingan, guna keamanan dan kenyamanan  korban dari ancaman dan bahaya pelaku.
27. Standar Operasional Prosedur yang selanjutnya disingkat  SOP adalah langkah-langkah standar yang harus dilakukan  dalam melindungi korban mulai dari pengaduan/ identifikasi,  rehabilitasi, kesehatan, rehabilitasi sosial, layanan hukum  sampai dengan pemulangan dan reintegrasi sosial saksi  dan/atau korban.
28. Kabupaten Layak Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat KLA  adalah kabupaten yang mempunyai sistem pembangunan  berbasis Hak Anak melalui pengintegrasian komitmen dan  sumberdaya pemerintah, masyarakat dan dunia usaha yang  terencana secara menyeluruh dan berkelanjutan dalam  kebijakan, program dan kegiatan untuk menjamin  pemenuhan hak anak.
- 6 ­
29. Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Daerah, yang selanjutnya  disingkat APBD adaJah Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja  Daerah Kabupaten Buton.
translated_text:
REGIONAL REGULATION ON
IMPLEMENTATION OF
PROTECTION FOR WOMEN
AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regulation, what is meant by: 1. Region is Buton Regency. 2. Regional Government is the Regent as organizer of Regional Government administration in the implementation of governmental affairs which are the authority of the Autonomous Region.
3. Regent is the Regent of Buton as the element who leads and becomes
4. Regional Apparatus is the supporting element of the Regent and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of governmental affairs which are the authority of the Region.
5. Office of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection, hereinafter referred to as PPPA Office is the Office of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection of Buton Regency.
Child, Office Child - 4 -
6. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for Women and Child Protection, hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD-PPA is a regional technical implementation unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
7. Forum for Protection of Violence Victims, hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK is a coordination forum for handling victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner.
8. Woman is an adult human of female gender and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
9. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 years, including a child in the womb.
10. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother or adoptive father and/or adoptive mother.
11. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, husband and wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct lineage upward or downward up to the third degree.
12. Household is husband, wife, and children, people who have family relations due to blood relations, marriage, milk kinship, care, and representation, and/or domestic workers and reside in that household.
13. Guardian is a person or body who in reality exercises custodial power as a parent over a child.
14. Companion is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance to victims to conduct counseling, therapy and advocacy for strengthening and recovery of violence victims.
15. Judicial body is the general court which has the authority to receive, examine, and adjudicate, as well as resolve every case submitted to it, to realize law enforcement and justice.
16. Community is individuals, families, groups, and social organizations and/or community organizations.
17. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, and psychological to the victim.
18. Violence against women is any action that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or private life.
- 5-
19. Violence against children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, psychologically, sexually, neglect, exploitation, and other violence.
20. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence occurring in the area of Buton Regency.
21. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, court, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will occur, is occurring or has occurred.
22. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
23. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to the victim when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against the victim will occur, is occurring or has occurred.
24. Prosecution is the action of the public prosecutor to transfer a case to the competent district court in matters and according to the manner regulated in the law with a request that it be examined and decided by a judge in a court session.
25. Lawsuit is a notification accompanied by a request by an interested party to a judge to take action according to law against a person who has harmed him/her in a civil manner.
26. Safe House is a shelter for victims during the assistance process, for the safety and comfort of victims from threats and danger from perpetrators.
27. Standard Operating Procedure, hereinafter abbreviated as SOP is standard steps that must be taken in protecting victims starting from complaint/identification, rehabilitation, health, social rehabilitation, legal services up to repatriation and social reintegration of witnesses and/or victims.
28. Child-Friendly Regency, hereinafter abbreviated as KLA is a regency that has a Child Rights-based development system through the integration of commitment and resources of government, community and business world that is planned comprehensively and sustainably in policies, programs and activities to ensure the fulfillment of children's rights.
- 6 -
29. Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget, hereinafter abbreviated as APBD is the Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget of Buton Regency.

Pasal 3
Perlindungan perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan bertujuan  untuk:
a. mencegah segala bentuk kekerasan terhadap perempuan  dan anak;
b. memberikan pelayanan kepada korban; dan
c. melakukan pemberdayaan kepada perempuan korban  kekerasan.
Pasal4 Ruang lingkup pengaturan penyelenggaraan perlindungan  terhadap perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan dalam  peraturan daerah ini meliputi upaya pencegahan, pelayanan,  dan pemberdayaan terhadap korban kekerasan di Daerah.
translated_text:
Article 3
The protection of women and children victims of violence aims to:
a. prevent all forms of violence against women and children;
b. provide services to victims; and
c. empower women victims of violence.
Article 4 The scope of regulation for the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence in this regional regulation includes prevention efforts, services, and empowerment of victims of violence in the Region.

text:
Pasal 6
Kekerasan fisik sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5 huruf a  disebabkan karena perbuatan yang mengakibatkan rasa sakit,  cedera, luka atau cacat pada tubuh seseorang, gugumya  kandungan, pingsan dan/atau menyebabkan kematian.
translated_text:
Article 6
Physical violence as referred to in Article 5 letter a is caused by acts that result in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, loss of consciousness and/or cause death.

text:
Pasal 7
Kekerasan psikis sebaga.imana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5 huruf b  disebabkan karena perbuatan yang mengakibatkan ketakutan,  hilangnya rasa percaya diri, hilangnya kemampuan untuk  bertindak, rasa tidak berdaya dan/atau penderitaan psikis berat  pada seseorang.
translated_text:
Article 7
Psychological violence as referred to in Article 5 letter b is caused by acts that result in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and/or severe psychological suffering to a person.

text:
Pasal 9
Penelantaran sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5 huruf d  disebabkan karena:
a. perbuatan yang mengakibatkan tidak terpenuhinya  kebutuhan anak secara wajar, baik fisik, mental, spiritual  maupun sosial yang dilakukan oleh orang tua, wali, atau  pihak lain manapun yang bertanggung jawab atas  pengasuhannya;
b. perbuatan mengabaikan dengan sengaja untuk memelihara,  merawat, atau mengurus anak sebagaimana mestinya yang  dilakukan oleh orang tua, wali, atau pihak lain manapun  yang bertanggungjawab atas pengasuhannya;
c. perbuatan yang menelantarkan orang dalam lingkup rumah  tangganya, padahal menurut hukum yang berlaku baginya  atau karena persetujuan atau perjanjian ia wajib  memberikan kehidupan, perawatan, atau pemeliharaan  kepada orang tersebut; dan/atau
d. perbuatan yang mengakibatkan ketergantungan ekonomi  dengan cara membatasi dan/atau melarang untuk bekerja  yang layak di dalam atau di luar rumah sehingga korban  berada dibawah kendali orang tersebut.
- 8­
translated_text:
Article 9
Neglect as referred to in Article 5 letter d is caused by:
a. acts that result in the failure to fulfill the needs of a child properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social, committed by parents, guardians, or any other party responsible for their care;
b. acts of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or look after a child as appropriate, committed by parents, guardians, or any other party responsible for their care;
c. acts that neglect a person within the scope of their household, whereas according to the law applicable to them or due to an agreement or contract they are obligated to provide livelihood, care, or maintenance to that person; and/or
d. acts that result in economic dependence by means of restricting and/or prohibiting proper work inside or outside the home so that the victim is under the control of that person.
- 8­

text:
Pasal 10
Eksploitasi sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5 huruf e  disebabkan karena:
a. perbuatan yang mengeksploitasi ekonomi atau seksual  dengan maksud untuk menguntungkan diri sendiri atau  orang lain;
b. perbuatan yang dengan atau tanpa persetujuan korban yang  meliputi tapi tidak terbatas pada pelacuran, kerja atau  pelayanan paksa, perbudakan atau praktik serupa,  penindasan, pemerasan, pemanfaatan fisik, seksual, organ  reproduksi, atau secara melawan hukum memmdahkan atau  mentransplantasi organ dan/atau jaringan tubuh atau  memanfaatkan tenaga atau kemampuan seseorang oleh  pihak lain untuk mendapatkan keuntungan baik materiil  maupun immateriil; dan/atau
c. segala bentuk pemanfaatan organ tubuh seksual atau organ  tubuh lain dari korban untuk mendapatkan keuntungan,  termasuk tetapi tidak terbatas pada semua kegiatan  pelacuran atau pencabulan.
translated_text:
Article 10
Exploitation as referred to in Article 5 letter e is caused by:
a. acts that exploit economically or sexually with the intention of benefiting oneself or others;
b. acts with or without the consent of the victim which include but are not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, exploitation of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully removing or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or exploiting the labor or capabilities of a person by other parties to obtain benefits both material and immaterial; and/or
c. all forms of exploitation of sexual organs or other organs of the victim to obtain benefits, including but not limited to all activities of prostitution or sexual abuse.

text:
Pasal 1l
Kekerasan lainnya sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5 huruff  disebabkan karena:
a. ancaman kekerasan, meliputi setiap perbuatan secara  melawan hukum berupa ucapan, tulisan, gambar, simbol,  atau gerakan tubuh, baik dengan atau tanpa menggunakan  sarana yang menimbulkan rasa takut atau mengekang  kebebasan hakiki seseorang; dan
b. pemaksaan, meliputi suatu keadaan dimana  seseorang/korban disuruh melakukan sesuatu sedemikian  rupa sehingga orang itu melakukan sesuatu yang  berlawanan dengan kehendak sendiri.
translated_text:
Article 1l
Other violence as referred to in Article 5 letter f is caused by:
a. threat of violence, includes any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, image, symbol, or body movement, whether with or without using means that cause fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom; and
b. coercion, includes a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something that is contrary to their own will.

text:
Pasal 17
(1) Pencegahan kekerasan terhadap perempuan dan anak  dilakukan secara terpadu oleh Pemerintah Daerah yang  dikoordinasikan oleh perangkat daerah yang mempunyai  tugas pokok dan fungsi koordinasi di bidang pemberdayaan  perempuan dan perlindungan anak.
(2) Upaya pencegahan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat ( 1)  dilaksanakan dengan cara:
a. membentuk jaringan kerja dalam upaya pencegahan  kekerasan;
b. melakukan koordinasi, integrasi, sinkronisasi  pencegahan kekerasan berdasarkan pola kemitraan;  c. memberikan konseling/bimbingan;
d. melakukan sosialisasi tentang peraturan perundang  undangan yang berkaitan dengan perlindungan  perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan; dan
e. memberikan pendidikan kritis tentang hak perempuan  dan anak bagi masyarakat.

text:
Pasal 19
(1) Dalam rangka penyelenggaraan pelayanan terpadu terhadap  Korban, Pemerintah Daerah membentuk UPTD-PPA.  (2) Pelaksanaan pelayanan terhadap korban oleh UPTD-PPA  sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dapat dilimpahkan  kepada unit pelayanan lainnya secara berjejaring.  (3) Dalam melaksanakan pelayanan terhadap korban  sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), UPTD-PPA berada di  bawah dan bertanggung jawab kepada Kepala Dinas PPPA  dan wajib berkoordinasi dengan bidang terkait.
(4] Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai pembentukan dan tata  kerja UPTD-PPA sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) diatur  dengan Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 19
(1) In the context of implementing integrated services for Victims, the Regional Government establishes UPTD-PPA.
(2) The implementation of services for victims by UPTD-PPA as referred to in paragraph (1) may be delegated to other service units in a networked manner.
(3) In implementing services for victims as referred to in paragraph (1), UPTD-PPA is under and responsible to the Head of PPPA Office and must coordinate with related fields.
(4) Further provisions regarding the establishment and working procedures of UPTD-PPA as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

text:
Pasal 24
(I) Pelayanan rehabilitasi sosial sebagaimana dimaksud dalam  Pasal 20 huruf d merupakan pelayanan yang diberikan  pendamping dalam rangka:
a. memulihkan kondisi traumatis korban, termasuk  penyediaan rumah aman untuk melindungi korban dari  berbagai ancaman dan intimidasi; dan
b. memberikan dukungan secara sosial sehingga korban  mempunyai rasa percaya diri, kekuatan dan kemandiriam  dalam menyelesaikan masalah.
- 13­ (2) Pelayanan rehabilitasi sosial sebagaimana dimaksud pada  ayat (1) dilakukan dengan cara:
a. bimbingan kerohanian kepada korban; dan
b. pemulihan kejiwaan korban.
translated_text:
Article 24
(I) Social rehabilitation services as referred to in Article 20 letter d constitute services provided by companions in order to:
a. restore the traumatic condition of victims, including the provision of safe houses to protect victims from various threats and intimidation; and
b. provide social support so that victims have self-confidence, strength and independence in resolving problems.
- 13­ (2) Social rehabilitation services as referred to in paragraph (1) are carried out by means of:
a. spiritual guidance to victims; and
b. psychological recovery of victims.

text:
Pasal 25
{1) Pelayanan bantuan hukum sebagaimana dimaksud dalam  Pasal 20 huruf e merupakan jasa yang diberikan untuk  membantu korban dalam menjalani proses peradilan.
(2) Pelayanan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam ayat (1) berupa:  a. konsultasi hukum yang mencakup informasi mengenai  hak korban dan proses peradilan;
b. pendampingan korban di tingkat penyidikan, penuntutan  dan pemeriksaan dalam sidang pengadilan dan  membantu korban untuk secara lengkap memaparkan  kekerasan yang dialaminya,
c. koordinasi dengan sesama penegak hukum, relawan  pendamping, dan pekerja sosial agar proses peradilan  berjalan sebagaimana mestinya; dan
d. pelaporan perkembangan kasus.
translated_text:
Article 25
(1) Legal aid services as referred to in Article 20 letter e constitute services provided to assist victims in undergoing the judicial process.
(2) Services as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in the form of:
a. legal consultation which includes information regarding the rights of victims and the judicial process;
b. assistance to victims at the investigation, prosecution and examination levels in court proceedings and assisting victims to comprehensively describe the violence they have experienced;
c. coordination with fellow law enforcers, volunteer assistants, and social workers so that the judicial process proceeds as it should; and
d. reporting on case developments.

text:
Pasal 26
(1) Pelayanan pemulangan Korban dan reintegrasi sosial  sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 20 huruf f bertujuan  untuk mengembalikan korban kepada keluarga dan  lingkungan sosialnya.
(2) Pelayanan pemulangan dan reintegrasi sosial sebagaimana  dimaksud pada ayat (l) dilakukan setelah terlaksananya  sosialisasi terkait hak-hak perempuan sebagai korban.
(3) Pelayanan pemulangan dan reintegrasi sosial sebagaimana  dimaksud pada ayat (I) dilakukan oleh Pemerintah Daerah  berkoordinasi dengan:
a. Pemerintah Daerah Provinsi;
b. Pemerintah Daerah lainnya; dan
c. instansi dan lembaga pemerintah maupun  nonpemerintah terkait.
translated_text:
Article 26
(1) The service for repatriation of Victims and social reintegration as referred to in Article 20 letter f aims to return victims to their families and social environment.
(2) The service for repatriation and social reintegration as referred to in paragraph (l) shall be carried out after the implementation of socialization related to the rights of women as victims.
(3) The service for repatriation and social reintegration as referred to in paragraph (I) shall be carried out by the Regional Government in coordination with:
a. Provincial Regional Government;
b. other Regional Governments; and
c. related government and non-government agencies and institutions.

Article 28
Forms of empowerment for women victims of violence include:
a. job training;
b. productive economic enterprises and joint business groups; and
c. capital assistance.

text:
Pasal 29

a. pelatihan ketrampilan;
b. praktek kerja lapangan; dan
c. pemagangan.
translated_text:
Article 29
Job training as referred to in Article 28 letter a, includes:
a. skills training;
b. field work practice; and
c. apprenticeship.

Article 30
Productive economic enterprises and joint business groups as referred to in Article 28 letter b, include:
a. entrepreneurial skills training;
b. facilitation of joint business group formation; and
c. assistance in business implementation.

text:
Pasal 31
Bantuan permodalan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 28  huruf c, meliputi:
a. bantuan sarana dan prasarana; dan
b. fasilitasi bantuan modal kerja.
translated_text:
Article 31
Capital assistance as referred to in Article 28 letter c, includes:
a. assistance for facilities and infrastructure; and
b. facilitation of working capital assistance.

text:

# BUPATI BUTON REGULATION
NUMBER 45 OF 2016

REGARDING

PROCEDURES FOR GRANTING AND UTILIZING INCENTIVES FOR TAX COLLECTION AND REGIONAL LEVIES

BY THE GRACE OF ALMIGHTY GOD

BUPATI BUTON,

Considering : a. that in order to implement the provisions of Article 22 paragraph (1) of Government Regulation Number 69 of 2010 concerning Procedures for Granting and Utilizing Incentives for Tax Collection and Regional Levies, it is necessary to regulate the Procedures for Granting and Utilizing Incentives for Tax Collection and Regional Levies;

b. that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a, it is necessary to establish a Bupati Regulation regarding Procedures for Granting and Utilizing Incentives for Tax Collection and Regional Levies;

In View of : 1. Law Number 8 of 1981 regarding Criminal Procedure Law (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 1981 Number 76, Supplement to State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 3209);

2. Law Number 17 of 2003 regarding State Finance (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2003 Number 47, Supplement to State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4286);

3. Law Number 1 of 2004 regarding State Treasury (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2004 Number 5, Supplement to State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4355);

4. Law Number 15 of 2004 regarding Audit of Management and Responsibility of State Finance (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2004 Number 66, Supplement to State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4400);

5. Law Number 33 of 2004 regarding Financial Balance between Central Government and Regional Governments (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2004 Number 126, Supplement to State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4438);

6. Law Number 28 of 2009 regarding Regional Taxes and Regional Levies (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2009 Number 130, Supplement to State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5049);

7. Law Number 12 of 2011 regarding Formation of Legislation Regulations (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2011 Number 82, Supplement to State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5234);

8. Law Number 23 of 2014 regarding Regional Government (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2014 Number 244, Supplement to State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5587) as amended several times, most recently by Law Number 9 of 2015 regarding Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2014 regarding Regional Government (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2015 Number 58, Supplement to State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5679);

9. Government Regulation Number 58 of 2005 regarding Regional Financial Management (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2005 Number 140, Supplement to State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4578);

10. Government Regulation Number 69 of 2010 regarding Procedures for Granting and Utilizing Incentives for Tax Collection and Regional Levies (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2010 Number 119, Supplement to State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5161);

11. Government Regulation Number 12 of 2017 regarding Guidance and Supervision of Regional Government Administration (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2017 Number 73, Supplement to State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 6041);

12. Minister of Home Affairs Regulation Number 13 of 2006 regarding Guidelines for Regional Financial Management as amended by Minister of Home Affairs Regulation Number 21 of 2011 regarding Second Amendment to Minister of Home Affairs Regulation Number 13 of 2006 regarding Guidelines for Regional Financial Management (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2011 Number 310);

13. Minister of Home Affairs Regulation Number 80 of 2015 regarding Formation of Regional Legal Products (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2015 Number 2036);

14. Minister of Home Affairs Regulation Number 77 of 2020 regarding Technical Guidelines for Regional Financial Management (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2020 Number 1781);

15. Buton Regency Regional Regulation Number 1 of 2008 regarding Formation of Regional Organizational Structure and Work Procedures of Buton Regency Regional Apparatus (Buton Regency Regional Gazette of 2008 Number 1) as amended by Buton Regency Regional Regulation Number 6 of 2016 regarding Amendment to Buton Regency Regional Regulation Number 1 of 2008 regarding Formation of Regional Organizational Structure and Work Procedures of Buton Regency Regional Apparatus (Buton Regency Regional Gazette of 2016 Number 6);

16. Buton Regency Regional Regulation Number 1 of 2012 regarding Regional Taxes (Buton Regency Regional Gazette of 2012 Number 1, Supplement to Buton Regency Regional Gazette Number 1);

17. Buton Regency Regional Regulation Number 2 of 2012 regarding Regional Levies (Buton Regency Regional Gazette of 2012 Number 2, Supplement to Buton Regency Regional Gazette Number 2);

HAS DECIDED:

To Establish : BUPATI REGULATION REGARDING PROCEDURES FOR GRANTING AND UTILIZING INCENTIVES FOR TAX COLLECTION AND REGIONAL LEVIES.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Bupati Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is Buton Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Bupati as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs which are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Bupati is the Bupati of Buton.
4. Regional Revenue and Asset Management Agency, hereinafter abbreviated as BPKAD, is the Regional Revenue and Asset Management Agency of Buton Regency.
5. Regional Apparatus Work Unit, hereinafter abbreviated as SKPD, is the Regional Apparatus Work Unit within the Buton Regency Government.
6. Regional General Treasury, hereinafter abbreviated as KUD, is an official authorized to carry out the duties of the Regional General Treasurer.
7. Regional General Treasurer, hereinafter abbreviated as BUD, is an official authorized to carry out the duties of the Regional General Treasurer.
8. Regional Tax is a mandatory contribution to the Region owed by an individual or entity that is coercive in nature based on law, without receiving direct compensation and is used for regional needs for the greatest prosperity of the people.
9. Regional Levy is a regional levy as payment for services or granting of specific permits specifically provided and/or given by the Regional Government for the benefit of individuals or entities.
10. Tax Collection is a series of activities starting from data collection of tax objects and/or subjects, determination of the amount of tax owed up to tax collection activities to taxpayers as well as supervision of its collection.
11. Levy Collection is a series of activities starting from registration of levy objects and subjects, determination of the amount of levy owed up to levy collection activities from levy payers as well as supervision of its collection.
12. Incentive is an additional income given to employees and/or apparatus who carry out certain activities.
13. Tax and Levy Collection Incentive is an incentive given to employees and/or apparatus who carry out tax and levy collection activities.
14. Regional Revenue Budget is the estimated amount of regional revenue planned in 1 (one) budget year.
15. Regional Revenue Realization is the amount of regional revenue that has been realized in 1 (one) budget year.
16. Tax and Levy Revenue Realization is the amount of tax and levy revenue that has been realized in 1 (one) budget year.

CHAPTER II
SCOPE

Article 2

The scope of this Bupati Regulation includes:
a. granting of incentives; and
b. utilization of incentives.

CHAPTER III
GRANTING OF INCENTIVES

Part One
Incentive Recipients

Article 3

(1) Incentive recipients consist of:
a. Head of BPKAD;
b. Secretary of BPKAD;
c. Head of Field at BPKAD;
d. Head of Sub-Division at BPKAD Secretariat;
e. Head of Section at BPKAD;
f. Staff at BPKAD; and
g. Other parties outside BPKAD employees who assist in tax and levy collection activities.

(2) Other parties as referred to in paragraph (1) letter g include:
a. Camat;
b. Village Head; and
c. Neighborhood Head/Hamlet Head.

Part Two
Incentive Amount

Article 4

(1) The amount of incentive given to incentive recipients as referred to in Article 3 paragraph (1) is a maximum of 3% (three percent) of the realization of tax and levy revenue receipts in 1 (one) budget year.

(2) The amount of incentive as referred to in paragraph (1) is allocated with the following details:
a. a maximum of 2% (two percent) for BPKAD employees; and
b. a maximum of 1% (one percent) for other parties outside BPKAD employees.

(3) The amount of incentive as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a is distributed with the following details:
a. Head of BPKAD receives a maximum of 12% (twelve percent);
b. Secretary of BPKAD receives a maximum of 10% (ten percent);
c. Head of Field at BPKAD receives a maximum of 9% (nine percent);
d. Head of Sub-Division at BPKAD Secretariat receives a maximum of 7% (seven percent);
e. Head of Section at BPKAD receives a maximum of 7% (seven percent); and
f. Staff at BPKAD receive a maximum of 55% (fifty-five percent).

(4) The amount of incentive as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b is distributed with the following details:
a. Camat receives a maximum of 30% (thirty percent);
b. Village Head receives a maximum of 40% (forty percent); and
c. Neighborhood Head/Hamlet Head receives a maximum of 30% (thirty percent).

Part Three
Incentive Granting Mechanism

Article 5

(1) Incentive granting is carried out after the end of the budget year.

(2) Incentive granting as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out after deducting all tax and levy revenue sharing that must be transferred to the village.

(3) Incentive granting as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out based on a Bupati Decree.

(4) Bupati Decree as referred to in paragraph (3) is issued based on a proposal from the Head of BPKAD.

Article 6

(1) Incentive granting is carried out by taking into account the realization of tax and levy revenue receipts in 1 (one) budget year.

(2) In the event that the realization of tax and levy revenue receipts as referred to in paragraph (1) is equal to or greater than the regional revenue budget, incentive granting is carried out at a maximum of 3% (three percent).

(3) In the event that the realization of tax and levy revenue receipts as referred to in paragraph (1) is less than the regional revenue budget, incentive granting is carried out proportionally.

Article 7

Incentive granting is carried out by crediting to the account of each incentive recipient.

CHAPTER IV
UTILIZATION OF INCENTIVES

Article 8

(1) Incentive utilization is carried out to improve the performance and welfare of incentive recipients.

(2) Incentive utilization as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by incentive recipients in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

CHAPTER V
REPORTING

Article 9

(1) The Head of BPKAD submits a report on the granting and utilization of incentives to the Bupati through the Regional Secretary.

(2) The report as referred to in paragraph (1) is submitted every semester.

CHAPTER VI
SUPERVISION

Article 10

(1) Supervision of the granting and utilization of incentives is carried out by the Regional Inspectorate.

(2) Supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

CHAPTER VII
TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS

Article 11

At the time this Bupati Regulation comes into force, the granting and utilization of incentives for tax and levy collection that have been carried out before the enactment of this Bupati Regulation are declared to remain valid.

CHAPTER VIII
CLOSING PROVISIONS

Article 12

This Bupati Regulation comes into force on the date of promulgation.

In order that everyone may know of it, the promulgation of this Bupati Regulation is ordered by its placement in the Buton Regency Regional Gazette.

Enacted in Pasarwajo
on December 28, 2016

BUPATI BUTON,
Stamp/signature

TENTANG
PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK KORBAN KEKERASAN
I. UMUM
Negara memiliki kewajiban memberikan perlindungan kepada warga  Negara sesuai dengan pembuakaan UUD Negara Republik Indonesia Tahun  1945. Bahwa perempuan dan anak temasuk kelompok rentan yang  cenderung mengalami kekerasan sehingga perlu mendapatkan perlindungan.  Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak tersebut merupakan pelanggaran  hak asasi manusia sehingga perlu dilindungi harga diri dan martabatnya  serta dijamin hak hidupnya tanpa adanya diskriminasi Kekerasan merupakan setiap perbuatan secara melawan hukum  dengan atau tanpa menggunakan sarana terhadap fisik dan psikis yang  menimbulkan bahaya bagi nyawa, badan atau menimbulkan terampasnya  kemerdekaan seseorang.
Selanjutnya kekerasan terhadap perempuan merupakan setiap  tindakan berdasarkan perbedaan jenis kelamin yang berakibat atau mungkin  berakibat kesengsaraan atau mungkin berakibat kesengsaraan atau  penderitaan perempuan secara fisik, seksual atau psikologis, termasuk  ancaman tindakan tertentu, pemaksaan atau perarnpasan kemerdekaan  secara sewenang-wenang, baik yang terjadi di ranah publik atau dalam  kehidupan pribadi. Kekerasan terhadap anak adalah setiap perbuatan  terhadap anak yang berakibat timbulnya kesengsaraan atau penderitaan  secara fisik, mental, seksual, psikologis, termasuk penelantaran dan  perlakuan buruk yang mengancam integritas tubuh dan merendahkan  martabat anak. Keberadaan Perempuan dan Anak Korban Kekerasan belum  mendapatkan pelayanan yang memadai sehingga diperlukan pelayanan  minimal untk korban kekerasan.
Da\am rangka mencegah dan menanggulangi kekerasan terhadap  perempuan dan anak di Kabupaten Buton agar terhindar dari kekerasan,  ancaman kekerasan, penyiksaan atau perlakuan yang merendahkan derajat  dan martabat kemanusiaan, perlu dilakukan perlindungan terhadap  perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan khususnya dalam hal pelayanan,  pemantauan dan evaluasi, pelaporan, pendanaan, pembinaan dan  pengawasan terhadap perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan.

EXPLANATION
OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF BUTON REGENCY
NUMBER 6 OF 2021
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has an obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services for victims of violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.
